messages:
Ana: Heads up — after the nccl bump we rolled to a subset of us-east2 (2.24.0) we're seeing intermittent allgather stalls on A100 NVLink hosts. Not full hangs but 10-30s tail latencies that blow SLOs.
Mike: Which other bits changed in that rollout? driver/CUDA? :thinking:
Ana: We also pushed driver CUDA 12.3 (535.54) cluster-wide last night. My suspicion is an NCCL <-> NVLink interaction.
Jordan: I reproduced on a 4-GPU pod with seq_len ~ 2500. Worker logs show repeated timeouts waiting inside ncclAllGather, stack ends up blocked in kernel launch. Snippet: 
```
[2026-03-18 02:12:34] WARN nccl: allgather: op stuck after 12000ms
[pid 4321] waiting at ../src/transport/p2p.c:214
```
Liz: Have we seen user-facing failures or just latency? Any job retries?
Ana: Both. About 3% job retries in the canary pool and a handful of short-lived job failures. Queues are backing up on the scheduler but nodes are healthy (no OOMs).
deploy-bot: deploy cluster/nccl-2.24.0 completed by infra-cd at 1832499900
Mike: Quick mitigation — try disabling P2P to force socket fallback: `export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` and set `NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth+`; also `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO` for extra logs.
Jordan: Confirmed: setting `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` reduces stalls dramatically but throughput drops ~20% on our allreduce-heavy workload. Measured p99 latency went from 28s -> 3.2s, but throughput (tokens/sec) down 20%.
Ana: We're going to pause the rollout and roll back nccl on the canary pool to 2.23.4 to validate. I'll open a vendor ticket with traces.
Liz: Please also throttle new job scheduling into the affected pool so it doesn't cascade. I'll add a temporary capacity cap.
Mike: Another config to try in parallel: `NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1` if RDMA paths are implicated. Might trade perf for stability.
Jordan: Attaching a minimal repro (pasted here). It triggers the hang after ~10 iterations with default batch sizes: 
```
# repro.py
import torch, torch.distributed as dist
dist.init_process_group('nccl', init_method='env://', world_size=4)
for i in range(100):
    x = torch.randn(1, 4096).cuda()
    gathered = [torch.zeros_like(x) for _ in range(dist.get_world_size())]
    dist.all_gather(gathered, x)
```
Ana: Created internal ticket RFC-1123 and linked logs+perf counters (nvlink error counters showing spikes). Ticket: https://redwood.internal/infra/tickets/RFC-1123 (open).
SRE-Tom: I'll grab kernel traces (ftrace) and NVLink error stats from the nodes in the canary pool now. Expect a follow-up in ~30m.
Mike: OK plan: 1) pause rollout, 2) rollback canary nccl to 2.23.4, 3) throttle scheduling, 4) gather ftrace + nvlink + nccl logs, 5) vendor escalation with repro.
Ana: Yep. I'll post the rollback timeline and a diff of the rollout script when it's scheduled. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
